providerDefinitionVectors.definitionUtf8: source=PCIe Extended Capability ID 0x0003; require exactly one capability; read bytes at capability+4 through +11 in ascending PCI configuration-space address order; bytes 0..3 are Serial Number Low DWORD little-endian and bytes 4..7 are Serial Number High DWORD little-endian; canonicalSerialBytes=the uint64 value encoded as exactly eight big-endian bytes; reject zero and all-ones; hash=SHA-256(ASCII("QMAN-DIRECTPATH/SERIAL-VALUE/V1") || 0x00 || ASCII(providerId) || 0x00 || canonicalSerialBytes).

source=complete PCI VPD resource image; parse PCI VPD large-resource records with little-endian lengths; require exactly one read-only-product-data SN keyword and a valid End Tag; extracted bytes=SN value; decode strict UTF-8; reject NUL, C0 and C1 controls; remove only leading and trailing U+0020; normalize Unicode NFC; reject empty; canonicalSerialBytes=UTF-8(normalized text); hash=SHA-256(ASCII("QMAN-DIRECTPATH/SERIAL-VALUE/V1") || 0x00 || ASCII(providerId) || 0x00 || canonicalSerialBytes).

source and extraction are defined by a signed qualification-bound vendor extractor profile identified by vendorExtractorId and vendorExtractorDefinitionDigest; require an exact byte slice and deterministic output of 1..4096 bytes; canonicalSerialBytes=the profile output without further transformation; hash=SHA-256(ASCII("QMAN-DIRECTPATH/SERIAL-VALUE/V1") || 0x00 || ASCII(providerId) || 0x00 || canonicalSerialBytes).

source=ACPI namespace firmware node, never a Linux sysfs alias or PCI BDF; require the canonical absolute namespace path of four-character uppercase NameSeg components and the device _ADR value; physicalPath="acpi:/" + slash-separated NameSegs + "#adr=" + the unsigned _ADR encoded as exactly sixteen lowercase hexadecimal digits.

source=one unique populated SMBIOS Type 9 System Slots record, never its segment/bus/device/function fields; normalize Slot ID as four lowercase hexadecimal digits; decode Slot Designation as strict UTF-8, remove only leading and trailing U+0020, normalize NFC, then RFC3986 percent-encode every byte except ALPHA, DIGIT, hyphen, period, underscore and tilde using uppercase hex; physicalPath="smbios-system-slot:/slot-id=" + slotId + "/designation=" + encodedDesignation + "/function=" + decimal function 0..7.

source=Open Firmware device node full_name, never a Linux sysfs alias or PCI BDF string; require an absolute slash-separated DeviceTree path with no empty, dot or dot-dot segments and lowercase hexadecimal unit-address cells; physicalPath="devicetree:" + full_name + "#function=" + decimal function 0..7.

functionRoleDefinition.definitionUtf8: Map PCI classCode base byte 00,01,02,03,04,05,06,07,08,09,0a,0b,0c,0d,0e,0f,10,11,12,13,40 respectively to UNCLASSIFIED,MASS_STORAGE_CONTROLLER,NETWORK_CONTROLLER,DISPLAY_CONTROLLER,MULTIMEDIA_CONTROLLER,MEMORY_CONTROLLER,BRIDGE_DEVICE,SIMPLE_COMMUNICATION_CONTROLLER,BASE_SYSTEM_PERIPHERAL,INPUT_DEVICE_CONTROLLER,DOCKING_STATION,PROCESSOR,SERIAL_BUS_CONTROLLER,WIRELESS_CONTROLLER,INTELLIGENT_CONTROLLER,SATELLITE_COMMUNICATION_CONTROLLER,ENCRYPTION_CONTROLLER,SIGNAL_PROCESSING_CONTROLLER,PROCESSING_ACCELERATOR,NON_ESSENTIAL_INSTRUMENTATION,COPROCESSOR; map every other base byte to RESERVED_OR_VENDOR_SPECIFIC; subclass and programming-interface bytes do not change the V1 role.
